selectionGuide.description: SpongeBob's exaggerated pose turns a quoted statement into a taunting imitation, usually through a repeated caption.
bestFor: parodying a recognizable claim by echoing its wording
dismissing a weak excuse or argument with exaggerated imitation
mocking a familiar complaint, rule, or repeated phrase
avoidWhen: the response needs a nuanced rebuttal rather than ridicule
there is no specific statement to quote or imitate
the subject is sensitive enough that taunting would obscure the point

mechanics.visual: The contorted character expression supplies the contempt, so the image reads as imitation rather than a neutral quotation.
mechanics.text: Put the original statement in top and its recognizable alternating-case parody in bottom, preserving enough wording for the echo to land.

slots.name: bottom
slots.hint: the same statement in mOcKiNg CaSe
